title: Add shape filter with bulk inline editing to product management

requirements.summary: Add shape filter buttons above ProductManagementTable displaying unique shape values with 'All' option, matching marketplace filter UI styling
acceptanceCriteria: Shape filter buttons appear above the product management table
Buttons display all unique shape values from products plus 'All' option
Button styling matches the marketplace filter button design
Active filter button has distinct visual styling
Clicking a shape button filters the table to show only products with that shape
Clicking 'All' shows all products regardless of shape

file_operations.description: Add shape filter button UI above the table. Extract unique shape values from the products array using useMemo. Create a filter button row that includes 'All' plus each unique shape. Apply the same button styling used in the Marketplace component for shape filters (verify Marketplace component styling before implementing). Ensure the active filter button has distinct visual styling to indicate the selected filter.

requirements.summary: Implement React state management for shape filter selection and product filtering logic that works with checkbox selection
acceptanceCriteria: State tracks currently selected shape filter (or 'All')
Product table rows are filtered based on selected shape
Filter works independently of checkbox selection state
Existing checkbox selection remains functional after filtering
Selected products remain selected when changing shape filter
Filter state persists during inline editing operations

file_operations.description: Add useState hook to track the selected shape filter (default to 'All'). Apply filtering logic using useMemo to create a filteredProducts array based on the active shape filter. Use filteredProducts for rendering table rows instead of the full products array. Ensure the existing checkbox selection state (selectedProductIds) remains intact when switching between shape filters. Verify that selectedProductIds can reference products not currently visible due to filtering.

requirements.summary: Add bulk inline editing functionality where editing one selected product applies changes to all selected products simultaneously with visual feedback
acceptanceCriteria: When multiple products are selected via checkboxes and one product enters edit mode, changes apply to all selected products
All editable fields support bulk editing: title, description, shape, category, price, inventory count
Visual indicator shows which products will receive bulk changes
Confirmation dialog appears before applying bulk changes
Success notification displays count of products updated
Error handling shows which products failed to update if any
Bulk edit works with filtered product views (shape filter active)
After bulk update, all affected products show updated values immediately

file_operations.description: Modify the inline editing logic to detect when multiple products are selected via checkboxes. When a user edits a field (name, description, shape, category, price, or inventory count) on one product and that product is part of a multi-selection, capture the change and prepare for bulk update. Add visual indicators (e.g., background highlighting or badge) on selected product rows to show they will receive bulk changes. Before applying changes, display a confirmation dialog showing the count of products that will be updated. On confirmation, call the useBulkUpdateProducts mutation hook (REQ-112) passing all selected product IDs and the changed field values. Display a toast notification with the count of successfully updated products. Handle errors by showing which products failed to update. Ensure the table reflects updated values immediately after successful bulk update. Verify that bulk editing works correctly when the shape filter is active (i.e., only visible selected products should be editable, but all selected product IDs should receive updates).

requirements.summary: Create useBulkUpdateProducts React Query mutation hook that updates multiple products with the same field values and invalidates cache
acceptanceCriteria: Hook accepts array of product IDs and update object with modified fields
Calls backend updateProduct for each product ID with same field values
Returns success/failure status for each product update
Invalidates product queries after successful bulk update
Provides error details for any failed updates
Supports optimistic updates for immediate UI feedback

file_operations.description: Add a new useBulkUpdateProducts mutation hook. The hook should accept an input object containing an array of product IDs and an update object with the modified field values (name, shape, price, stripeProductId, stripeProductDescription, images, inventoryCount, category). Use Promise.allSettled to call actor.updateProduct for each product ID with the same field values. Collect the results to track which updates succeeded and which failed. On successful completion, invalidate the 'products' query key to refresh the product list. Return detailed status information including the count of successful updates and any error details for failed updates. Optionally implement optimistic updates by updating the query cache before the backend calls complete.
